observations.why: The act of switching to a new, unfamiliar database names novelty and departure from the status quo as the appealed-to good.
Quantified performance gain appeals to achievement and mastery while the cost claim frames a competitive winning edge.
The arrow notation restates the migration as a directional move toward novelty, reinforcing the openness-to-change appeal.
The quantified performance metric appeals to mastery and capability of the system's craft.
Setting a concrete timeline appeals to order, planning, and stability of the migration effort.
